title: What a QA result proves
situations: An item has checks before merge and acceptance after delivery.
One release contains several items and a run-wide check.
A user runs a saved plan without an item.
Evidence exists for a different environment or candidate.
Required QA lacks a usable target or machine.
current: Research trace; requirements and source paths need live proof.
questions: Subject and target contracts/read surfaces inspected; delivery admission and machine configuration are other auditors scopes, not re-proven here.
Command nodes, when present, were checked with installed CLI --help only; this proves parser/help availability, not serving-control-plane capability or successful execution.
